scripts.test: node --test tests/utils.test.mjs tests/store.test.mjs tests/pomodoro.test.mjs tests/day-plan.test.mjs tests/task-reminders.test.mjs
scripts.sync: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path www) { Remove-Item www -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force www | Out-Null; Copy-Item index.html,style.css,app.mjs,manifest.json,icon.svg,supabase.min.js,sortable.min.js,sw.js -Destination www -Force; if (Test-Path src) { Copy-Item src -Destination www -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path assets) { Copy-Item assets -Destination www -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path icons) { Copy-Item icons -Destination www -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path android\app\src\main\assets\public) { Remove-Item android\app\src\main\assets\public -Recurse -Force }" && npx cap sync android
